question: Why did the applied SMC HTF Confluence instance report 'Compilation error: CE10156'?

channel.note: The chart legend badge exposes only the code. Pine is translated server-side, so the authoritative diagnostic is the pine-facade response body, captured by attaching a Playwright response listener while the source is written into the Pine editor.

beforeFix.note: Identical to the sha256 pinned by smc_r5_htf_session_rebuild_tradingview_2026-07-31.json.
beforeFix.line57: the standalone '[' that opens the _confirmed_tuple() return

afterFix.change: whitespace only - token-for-token identical, continuation indents moved off multiples of four

chartInstance.addedFrom: editor buffer with forceInsert, bypassing the stale saved instance
chartInstance.compileErrorBadge: absent on the fresh instance; the stale instance keeps its badge

rootCause: Pine treats a continuation line indented by a multiple of four spaces as a new local block, not as a continuation. The rebuilt source wrapped the _confirmed_tuple() return at eight spaces and the three request.security tuple destructures at four, so the parser hit end of line after '[' with no continuation.
verificationTraps: preflight compile_ok only scans for a visible editor error marker and reported true for a source the compiler rejects - TradingView can reveal the error only after Add to chart
addCurrentScriptToChart skips insertion on an existing legend match (add-to-chart-already-present), so a gate re-run after a source fix re-measures the stale instance and reports the old failure
mutations: added one additional SMC HTF Confluence instance to the private validation layout from the editor buffer
left an unsaved Pine editor draft
